title: Pick a Store for Transactional Checkout
description: A modest-scale checkout changes inventory, creates an order and needs customer relationships enforced. Which starting choice has the clearest fit?

options.text: A document store solely because the app has many registered users.
options.explanation: Registered-user count does not establish access patterns, write rate or transaction requirements.

options.text: PostgreSQL transactions and constraints, with indexes for the hot queries.
options.explanation: Multi-entity invariants and related reads fit relational transactions, constraints and joins. Other stores may support transactions too, but their semantics and costs need checking.

options.text: An expiring cache as the only inventory authority.
options.explanation: The design needs durable transactional state, not just fast temporary copies.

options.text: One copied customer record in every order with no update policy.
options.explanation: Denormalization can optimize a read shape, but it does not by itself enforce cross-entity rules or keep mutable copies consistent.
